# Credits

<!-- Generated from src/app/settings/credits-data.ts by `npm run credits`; do not edit by hand. -->

Island of Settlers by **shadowvzs** (game design and development). The same list is
shown in the game under Settings > About > Credits. Licence and processing notes per asset:
`../docs/reference/asset-credits.md` and each `assets/models/**/LICENSE.txt`.

Required attributions:

- "lowpoly pig" by fabiotambone (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/lowpoly-pig-26ae14bd0d2b4650b4bf878ca85ad06a), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: turned and scaled, texture resized and compressed, simplified Minimal mesh, game-made walk, feeding and tail rig.
- "Realistic Mallard Duck - Game Ready Asset" by 3Dima (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/realistic-mallard-duck-game-ready-asset-dd33cd2e30944a4aae2de1a06a828f4f), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: simplified to 1400 triangles, texture baked into vertex colours, turned and scaled; posed and recoloured for the hen and ducklings in game.
- "Curious Squirrel" by iRahulRajput (rt699448) (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/curious-squirrel-0b5e2372910c4bd18e5c2fe2f1ee0b4c), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: simplified to 1300 triangles, texture baked into vertex colours, turned and scaled; posed in game (hops, sitting up, climbing).
- "Cattail Plant" by SXuno (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/cattail-plant-c50630051edd4a7daa9708f6b31c021f), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: simplified to 444 triangles, textures baked into vertex colours, recoloured to the island palette and scaled per variant.
- "Antelope" by planeta-elefante (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/antelope-c6fc5649e53e4735b30426d5423ca7fa), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: reshaped to chamois anatomy (stockier trunk, thicker neck, shorter muzzle and tail, short hooked horns), chamois summer and winter coats painted as vertex colours, the idle, walk, run, graze and death clips baked into posed frames, a lying pose and a Minimal level of detail added.
- "Fox-rigged" by freddy1231 (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/fox-rigged-b8a7c0e7778741568dd3d4ad80a01249), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: simplified to about 3,150 (High) and 1,600 (Minimal) triangles, textures baked into vertex colours with a deeper winter rust, walk, run, standing, sniffing and sitting poses baked into posed frames, scaled to island units.
- "Realistic Animated Bear 3D Model" by WildMesh 3D (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/realistic-animated-bear-3d-model-bffc3c87d2d148ff8533e1cc8a11c9f1), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: simplified to about 3,150 (High) and 1,600 (Minimal) triangles, textures baked into vertex colours, idle, walk, trot, eating and lying clips baked into posed frames with the root motion removed, scaled to island units.
- "Italian White Wolf" by SDPM Esare (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/italian-white-wolf-1de9441cb0744c0d8459ce957b8d0a57), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: simplified to about 3,050 (High) and 1,500 (Minimal) triangles, texture baked into vertex colours with a paler, thicker winter coat, rigged (the source is static) and posed into standing, walk, trot, sniffing and lying frames, scaled to island units.
- "Wild Boar Family" by Dakta.Grower.Nzl (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/wild-boar-family-7e9228685a2d46c596cefb0ba9f07250), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: the boar and the piglet only, stood straight, hair cards dropped, simplified to about 3,100 and 2,500 (High) and half (Minimal) triangles, textures baked into vertex colours (a grizzled boar coat with a darker winter coat, piglet stripes), rigged (the source is static) and posed into standing, walk, trot, gallop, rooting, lying and death frames, scaled to island units.
- "Dotted White Seal - Free Giveaway" by Kugatsu Tsukai 3D Models Hub (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/dotted-white-seal-free-giveaway-676115a924214e8289b9e03fb9b9a4ab), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: recoloured to a harbour seal (grey with dark spots, a paler belly), simplified to about 3,100 (High) and 1,550 (Minimal) triangles, textures baked into vertex colours, rigged (the source is static) and posed into lying, looking, banana, crawling and swimming frames, scaled to island units.
- "Great blue heron Чапля північна" by faerbogdan99 (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/great-blue-heron-52cffc22bf2441468739ac3ba6d599aa), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: recoloured to a grey heron (white neck and face, grey back and wings, black primaries), simplified to about 2,800 (High) and 1,400 (Minimal) triangles, textures baked into vertex colours, rigged (the source is static), the folded wings copied into spreadable flight wings, posed into standing, walking, striking and flying frames, scaled to island units.
- "Animated Eagle" by Clement Abai (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/animated-eagle-de73b663acbc426e8e6c107fd25e08cd), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: recoloured from a bald eagle to a golden eagle (golden nape and crown, dark banded tail, dark-tipped bill), simplified to about 3,000 (High) and 1,500 (Minimal) triangles, texture baked into vertex colours, a wing beat, the glide and two banked glides baked into posed frames, turned upright and scaled to island units.
- "Elk Animated Stylized" by WildMesh 3D (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/elk-animated-stylized-26e54fa5c1d74edba61f5c5a97c95798), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: antler mesh only, decimated to 50 %, fitted onto the elk's head.
- "Centurion Helmet Low Res" by Gareth Boyd (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/centurion-helmet-low-res-b0e793861ed74087af510184427b0014), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: simplified, turned and straightened, neck guard reduced, fitted to each worker's head, crest replaced by a game-made horsehair crest.
- "Roman Helmet" by Tunca.Erkal (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/roman-helmet-1a8d44be026a4ea08e268ba186b5c36b), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: geometry only: simplified, straightened and scaled, dome lowered, repainted in steel and brass; cheek guards, bands, rosettes and knob added.
- "Eagle Sculpture" by jerryfisher (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/eagle-sculpture-811daf3a66fe4777a2d26b2fca951528), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Changes: plinth cropped, oriented onto the bow post, gold material, simplified from 200,000 to 7,996 (High) and 1,000 (Minimal) triangles.
